Tree Removal for Two Large Pine Trees Over a House and Service Drop

All American Tree Service recently completed a tree removal project in Chaney Branch, West Point, AL, involving two large pine trees positioned over a home and a service drop. Trees growing close to structures and overhead service lines can create a serious concern for property owners, especially when their size and location increase the risk of damage during severe weather or as branches decline.

Careful Pine Tree Removal in Chaney Branch

The customer needed the two oversized pines removed because they stood directly over the house and near the service drop. In situations like this, professional tree removal helps address potential hazards while protecting the surrounding property. The position of each tree matters: large limbs or a falling trunk can threaten roofing, exterior features, and overhead connections.

All American Tree Service provided tree removal in Chaney Branch with attention to the trees’ proximity to the home and service drop. Removing hazardous trees can help reduce the chance of unexpected damage and give homeowners greater confidence about the safety of their property. When a pine tree is leaning, shedding large limbs, or growing in a difficult location, an experienced tree service can assess whether removal is the right solution.
